SRE Bot: INCIDENT ALERT - TIMEOUT_SPIKE detected in eu-west-1 canary window. Error rate (5xx/timeouts) up ~6% over baseline, p95 from 120ms -> 2.3s, p99 ~12s. Tagging @Elena (oncall) :rotating_light:
Elena (oncall): On it. Seeing alerts, pulling up dashboard now. Is this only canary traffic or hitting prod routes?
Alex M.: Looks like canary only so far, route weight 5% to edge-proxy-v2. Metrics show spike aligned with canary start at 2487659900.
Priya R.: I see connection queues growing on grpc-multiplexer for the canary hosts. KV-cache warmup flag was accidentally disabled in the canary config -> cold K/V lookups causing stalls.
Jamal S.: Interesting — edge-proxy-v2 changed keepalive to 30s in canary, could be triggering gRPC connection churn + cold cache.
Elena (oncall): Customers: a subset of EU customers on dedicated instances reported timeouts. Not widespread but impacting latency-sensitive routes.
Alex M.: Can we rollback just the canary? Prefer rollback to full cluster for speed.
Priya R.: Agreed. Rolling back canary should revert keepalive and cache flags. Preparing rollback command.
Jamal S.: Also set circuit-breaker threshold lower to shed load from canary hosts until rollback completes.
Elena (oncall): Assigning customer comms to product alerts channel. I'll notify support to surface to impacted customers.
Deploy Bot: Deploy event 2026-03-14T12:05Z (canary edge-proxy-v2) initiated by @Alex M. Status: in_progress.
Alex M.: Rolling back canary now: ```bash
# rollback canary edge-proxy-v2
./deploy rollback --service=edge-proxy --target=canary --commit=2026-03-14T12:05Z
```
Alex M.: Running rollback...
Deploy Bot: Rollback command acknowledged. Starting rollback job 5691.
Priya R.: While rollback runs, patching live config to re-enable kv_cache_warmup=true on canary hosts to reduce cold-start pain if rollback takes time.
Jamal S.: Patch applied to runtime config via `kubectl patch` on canary pool, verifying.
Elena (oncall): Support updated: temporary mitigation in place, customers seeing reduced errors but still elevated p99. Keep monitoring.
Deploy Bot: Rollback job 5691 completed. Edge-proxy-v2 canary reverted to previous stable (commit 2026-03-14T11:45Z).
Alex M.: Post-rollback metrics: p95 down to 130ms, p99 down to ~300ms, 5xx back to baseline. Looks good.
Priya R.: We should still run a canary with kv_cache_warmup=true and keepalive=60s to validate. Also run cache warming before traffic shift next time.
Jamal S.: Root cause preliminary: simultaneously changed keepalive + disabled cache warmup in canary -> connection churn + cold K/V lookups amplified latency.
Elena (oncall): I'll open an incident ticket and assign owners for postmortem. Immediate actions: (1) postmortem, (2) add config linting to prevent disabling cache_warmup in canaries, (3) update runbook to force cache warm for canary traffic.
Alex M.: +1 to config linting. Also add a quick smoke test for p99 under small traffic load before canary shift.
Priya R.: I'll add the lint rule and the smoke test by EOD.
Elena (oncall): Thanks team. Closing alert once dashboards show stable for 30m. Marking this as Sev3 since impact was limited and rollback fixed quickly.
SRE Bot: Alert closed for incident TIMEOUT_SPIKE (canary eu-west-1) at 2487660600.
Elena (oncall): Filing postmortem and will ping when draft is ready. :memo: 
Alex M.: Good catch everyone. I'll follow up with the deploy checklist update. :thumbsup:
